entries.summary: Initial release: [oha_account_dashboard] shortcode replaces UWP iframe hack on /haunt-profile/ page
entries.notes: Profile card with avatar, display name, username, member status badge. Account actions card: Edit Account, Change Password, Privacy Settings, Track Orders (conditional on WC orders). Membership card (shown only if oha_member_id exists): status, member since, renews/expired date, member ID. Three-context CSS: PWA mode (floating cards, 58px touch targets, sticky tab nav), mobile web (<768px), desktop (>=768px). UWP profile chrome overrides: dark tab bar, hide cog button, hide profile header in PWA mode.

entries.summary: UWP account forms open in slide-in panel overlay (iframe) instead of navigating away
entries.notes: Clicking Edit Account/Change Password/Privacy now opens a fixed full-screen panel that slides in from the right. UWP form loads in an iframe with ?oha_panel=1 param. body.oha-panel-view body class strips Kadence header/footer/nav and UWP left tab sidebar from the loaded form page. OHA dark theme applied to form inputs in panel view. Back button slides panel away. profile-hub.js added for panel open/close logic.

entries.summary: Panel is now a right-side drawer on desktop so UWP profile tabs stay visible
entries.notes: On >= 768px non-PWA: panel is 460px right drawer with box-shadow. PWA mode overrides back to full-screen. Removed centered title from panel bar; back button now reads My Account for clarity.

entries.summary: Internal nav tabs in panel to switch between Edit Account, Password, Privacy without closing
entries.notes: Panel now has a 3-tab nav bar (Edit Account, Password, Privacy). Active tab highlighted with red underline. Clicking a tab changes iframe src without closing the panel. dashboard action rows pass data-panel-type to pre-select the correct tab on open.
